summary: The Dreamer runtime is switched on. It was disabled since 2026-08-21 after a fact extraction pass got stuck in a permanent retry loop; that state no longer exists in the database, verified before flipping.
details: The two adaptors that caused the outage stay inert — their own switches are still off, so turning the runtime on does not restart them.
This is what the note tier background work needs in order to run at all.
limitations: No background adaptor is enabled yet, so the runtime comes up idle until one is switched on.
